The term "ascitis" is a symptom, and "peritonitis" refers to inflammation of the peritoneal cavity. Both of these conditions, when severe, can be life-threatening. "Massive" in the context of ascites indicates that it was very, very large. "Pelvic" in "pelvic peritonum" means it was in the area of the pelvis. "Abdominal" in both "ascities" and the "pelvis" indicates it's in the abdomen. "Peritonum," "peritum," or "peri-tum" all mean "around" or "next to" the tumor.
